summary.text: Joe Emrick is a Republican state representative from Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 137 who has served since December 1, 2010 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He worked as a teacher before entering the legislature.

paragraphs.text: Joe Emrick earned a bachelor's degree in history and secondary education from Lycoming College and a master's degree in education from Kutztown University.

His professional experience includes teaching in the Stroudsburg and Pleasant Valley school districts and then in the Lower Moreland School District, and serving on the board of supervisors for Upper Nazareth Township.
For the 2023-2024 session, Ballotpedia lists Emrick as chair of the Commerce Committee.
